title: Two-disbursement loan: 1000 + 500 -> outstanding 1500, repay 1500 -> 0 (C53)

source.test: As a user I would like to fully repay a loan which was disbursed 2 times

grade: Assert outstanding tracks each disbursement (100000, then 150000) and the 150000-minor repayment clears it to 0.
